# Numbers

Arithmetic helpers. A result that is not a finite number (for example `sqrt(-1)`) is a `NON_FINITE` error rather than `NaN`.

Every function can be called as `f(x, ...)` or as a method, `x.f(...)`. In the signatures, `T` and `U` stand for any type, `T[]` is a list, `?` marks an optional parameter, and `(T, number) => boolean` is a lambda parameter.

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`round`](#round) | Rounds half away from zero, optionally to a number of decimal digits. |
| [`floor`](#floor) | Rounds down. |
| [`ceil`](#ceil) | Rounds up. |
| [`trunc`](#trunc) | Drops the fractional part. |
| [`abs`](#abs) | Absolute value. |
| [`sqrt`](#sqrt) | Square root. |
| [`clamp`](#clamp) | Limits a number to a range. |
| [`toFixed`](#tofixed) | Formats a number with a fixed number of decimals. |
| [`formatNumber`](#formatnumber) | Formats a number with grouping, e.g. 1,234.5, with optional decimals and locale (default "en-US"). |
| [`formatCurrency`](#formatcurrency) | Formats an amount in a currency (ISO 4217 code such as "EUR"), with an optional locale (default "en-US"). |
| [`min`](#min) | The smallest value (nulls are skipped); null for an empty list. |
| [`max`](#max) | The largest value (nulls are skipped); null for an empty list. |
| [`sum`](#sum) | The sum of the numbers in a list (nulls are skipped). |
| [`avg`](#avg) | The mean of the numbers in a list (nulls are skipped); null for no numbers. |

## round

Rounds half away from zero, optionally to a number of decimal digits.

- `round(number, number?): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
round(2.5) // => 3
round(-2.5) // => -3
round(3.14159, 2) // => 3.14
```

## floor

Rounds down.

- `floor(number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
floor(2.7) // => 2
floor(-2.1) // => -3
```

## ceil

Rounds up.

- `ceil(number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->

## sqrt

Square root.

- `sqrt(number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->

## clamp

Limits a number to a range.

- `clamp(number, number, number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
clamp(150, 0, 100) // => 100
(-5).clamp(0, 100) // => 0
```

## toFixed

Formats a number with a fixed number of decimals.

- `toFixed(number, number): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
toFixed(3.14159, 2) // => "3.14"
(2).toFixed(1) // => "2.0"
```

## formatNumber

Formats a number with grouping, e.g. 1,234.5, with optional decimals and locale (default "en-US").

- `formatNumber(number, number?, string?): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
formatNumber(1234567.891) // => "1,234,567.891"
formatNumber(1234.5, 2) // => "1,234.50"
formatNumber(1234.5, 2, "de-DE") // => "1.234,50"
```

## formatCurrency

Formats an amount in a currency (ISO 4217 code such as "EUR"), with an optional locale (default "en-US").

- `formatCurrency(number, string, string?): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
formatCurrency(1234.5, "EUR") // => "€1,234.50"
formatCurrency(1234.5, "EUR", "de-DE") // => "1.234,50 €"
formatCurrency(99, "JPY", "ja-JP") // => "¥99"
```

## min

The smallest value (nulls are skipped); null for an empty list.

- `min(T[]): T | null`
- `min(number, ...number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai

min([4, 2, 8]) // => 2
```

## max

The largest value (nulls are skipped); null for an empty list.

- `max(T[]): T | null`
- `max(number, ...number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
